metadata.title: Yuzu – Relieve Desk Pain in 5 Min | Personalized Stretching App
metadata.description: Yuzu is the personalized stretching app to relieve pain from sitting at a desk all day. 5-minute routines, no equipment needed, guided by a fun mascot. Available on the App Store.

hero.title: Your desk pain,
hero.subtitle: 5-minute stretching routines, personalized to your pain zone. No equipment, guided by your favorite mascot.

showcase.title: Stretching made simple. Try it for yourself.

feature1.title: Pick your pain zone
feature1.description: Neck, back, shoulders, legs… Tell Yuzu where it hurts. It builds a session 100% tailored to your needs.

feature2.title: Follow guided routines
feature2.description: Step-by-step illustrated exercises with a built-in timer. Every movement is explained simply so you can follow along without thinking.

feature3.title: Celebrate your progress
feature3.description: Yuzu cheers you on after every session. Track your streak and stay motivated with your lemon companion.

review1.text: Since using Yuzu, my back pain after work has almost disappeared. 5 minutes a day was all it took.
review1.author: Claire M.

review2.text: The mascot is adorable and the exercises are really easy to follow. I recommend it to all my remote-working colleagues.
review2.author: Thomas R.

review3.text: Finally a stretching app that doesn't require 30 minutes and equipment. I use it at my desk between meetings.
review3.author: Sophie L.

review4.text: My neck was killing me every evening. After 2 weeks with Yuzu, it's a whole different world. Thank you!
review4.author: Antoine D.

review5.text: Love the concept. The little lemon cheering you on is way better than austere fitness apps. I actually feel motivated.
review5.author: Julie P.

review6.text: Simple, effective, quick. Exactly what I needed for my tense shoulders after hours of coding.
review6.author: Marc B.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro:
Welcome to Yuzu!

Your privacy is extremely important to us. This Privacy Policy clearly and transparently explains what data we collect, why we collect it, how we use it, and what your rights are.

By using the App, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

section1.title: 1. FUNDAMENTAL PRINCIPLES
section1.content:
We commit to respecting the following principles:

✓ Transparency: Clearly informing you about our practices
✓ Minimization: Collecting only strictly necessary data
✓ Security: Protecting your data with best practices
✓ Control: Giving you control over your data
✓ Compliance: Respecting GDPR and applicable laws

section2.title: 2. DATA COLLECTED
section2.content:
2.1 Data You Provide to Us

PROFILE DATA
• First name (required)
• Age (optional)
• Gender (optional)

PREFERENCES AND GOALS DATA
• Main goal (flexibility, pain relief, posture, mobility, stress)
• Targeted body areas (full body, neck, back, shoulders, legs, feet)
• Specific flexibility goals
• Professional context (office, standing, physical, mixed, flexible)
• Fitness level (beginner, intermediate, advanced)
• Preferred time for exercises
• Reminder time (optional)

ACTIVITY DATA
• Session history (date, duration, type, difficulty)
• Completed exercises with dates
• Favorite exercises
• Custom sessions created
• Progress metrics (streaks, total exercises, total time)

2.2 Automatically Collected Data

TECHNICAL DATA
• Device identifier
• Device model and system version
• App version
• Device language
• Push notification token (if enabled)
• Time zone

USAGE DATA
• Usage dates and times
• Features used
• Errors and crashes (anonymized data)

2.3 Data We DO NOT Collect

✗ Last name
✗ Full postal address
✗ Phone number
✗ Banking information
✗ Precise GPS location
✗ Contacts
✗ Personal photos or videos
✗ Sensitive health data (medical diagnoses, treatments)
✗ Biometric data

section3.title: 3. USE OF DATA
section3.content:
We use your data to:

• Provide App services (Legal basis: Contract)
• Personalize your experience (Legal basis: Contract)
• Generate tailored programs (Legal basis: Contract)
• Save your progress (Legal basis: Contract)
• Sync across multiple devices (Legal basis: Contract)
• Send reminder notifications (Legal basis: Consent)
• Improve the App (Legal basis: Legitimate interest)
• Ensure security (Legal basis: Legitimate interest)
• Customer support (Legal basis: Legitimate interest)

You can withdraw your consent at any time for processing that depends on it.

section4.title: 4. DATA RETENTION
section4.content:
• Profile data and preferences: As long as your account is active
• Session history: As long as your account is active
• Favorite exercises: As long as your account is active
• Custom sessions: As long as your account is active
• Technical data and logs: 12 months maximum
• Customer support data: 3 years after ticket closure

AFTER ACCOUNT DELETION:
All your personal data is deleted within 30 days maximum.

section5.title: 5. DATA SHARING AND TRANSFER
section5.content:
We NEVER sell your personal data.

TECHNICAL SERVICE PROVIDERS

Supabase (Hosting and Database)
• Service: Supabase Inc.
• Location: Servers located in the European Union
• Role: Secure hosting, authentication, synchronization
• Protection: TLS and AES-256 encryption, SOC 2 Type II compliance

Notification Services (Apple/Google)
• Apple Push Notification Service (APNs) for iOS
• Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for Android
• Shared data: Only notification token and message content
• Control: Can be disabled at any time in settings

EU HOSTING
Your data is hosted exclusively in the European Union, ensuring the highest level of GDPR protection.

section6.title: 6. DATA SECURITY
section6.content:
6.1 Technical Measures

✓ Encryption in transit: TLS 1.3 for all communications
✓ Encryption at rest: AES-256 for stored data
✓ Secure authentication: Session management with JWT tokens
✓ Data isolation: Row Level Security (RLS) - each user only sees their own data
✓ Regular backups: Automatic daily backups
✓ Monitoring: 24/7 system monitoring

6.2 Organizational Measures

✓ Access restricted to authorized personnel only
✓ Principle of least privilege
✓ Regular security audits
✓ Team training on data protection

6.3 In Case of Data Breach

We commit to:
• Notify the supervisory authority (CNIL) within 72 hours
• Inform you without delay if the risk is high
• Take all necessary measures to limit the impact

section7.title: 7. YOUR DATA RIGHTS (GDPR)
section7.content:
7.1 Right of Access
You can request a copy of all your data. How? Settings > My data or contact us

7.2 Right of Rectification
You can correct inaccurate data. How? Modify directly in settings

7.3 Right to Erasure
You can request deletion of your data. How? Settings > Delete my data

7.4 Right to Portability
You can receive your data in structured format (JSON, CSV). How? Settings > Export my data

7.5 Right to Object
You can object to the processing of your data. How? Disable the relevant options in settings

7.6 Right to Withdraw Consent
For notifications, you can withdraw your consent at any time. How? Disable in Settings > Notifications

7.7 Right to Lodge a Complaint

If you believe your rights are not being respected:

CNIL (Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés)
3 Place de Fontenoy
TSA 80715
75334 PARIS CEDEX 07
Phone: 01 53 73 22 22
Website: https://www.cnil.fr/

RESPONSE TIME
We commit to responding to your requests within one month maximum.

section8.title: 8. CHILDREN'S DATA
section8.content:
The App is accessible to individuals aged 13 and over.

For users under 18, we strongly recommend obtaining parental consent.

If we discover that a child under 13 has provided personal data, we will immediately delete that data.

section9.title: 9. COOKIES AND SIMILAR TECHNOLOGIES
section9.content:
The App does not use cookies in the traditional sense.

LOCAL STORAGE
The App stores certain data locally on your device to:
• Improve performance
• Allow offline use
• Save your preferences

This data remains on your device and is deleted if you uninstall the App.

section10.title: 10. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY
section10.content:
We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our practices or legislation.

In case of significant changes:
• We will notify you via the App
• We will update the date at the top of this policy
• Your continued use constitutes acceptance of the new terms

section11.title: 11. CONTACT
section11.content:
For any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or to exercise your rights:

Email: yuzu.contactme@gmail.com

We commit to responding to your requests as quickly as possible.

YUZU'S COMMITMENTS

Respect your privacy
Be transparent about our practices
Give you control over your data
Protect your data with the best security measures
Never sell your data to third parties
Respond quickly to your requests

By using the Yuzu App, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and accepted this Privacy Policy.

Version 1.0 - November 2025 — Compliant with GDPR (EU 2016/679) and Apple App Store requirements

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro:
Welcome to Yuzu, a mobile application for personalized mobility and stretching exercises.

These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern access to and use of the Yuzu mobile application ("the App") and related services ("the Services").

By downloading, installing, or using the App, you unconditionally accept these Terms. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the App.

section1.title: 1. DEFINITIONS
section1.content:
• "User" or "You": any individual using the App.
• "We", "Our", "Yuzu": the publisher of the App.
• "Content": all information, text, images, videos, exercises, programs, and other elements available in the App.
• "Personal Data": any information that directly or indirectly identifies a User.

section2.title: 2. PURPOSE OF THE APP
section2.content: Personalized exercise programs, progress tracking, recommendations, reminders, favorites and custom sessions. The app is for general wellness and does not replace medical advice.

section3.title: 3. ACCESS AND USE CONDITIONS
section3.content: Minimum age 13; parental consent if under 18. Registration (first name, goals, preferences) and anonymous or permanent account. You agree to provide accurate information, not to use the app for illegal purposes, not to access other users' data, not to copy/modify the app, and to consult a healthcare professional in case of medical conditions.

section4.title: 4. HEALTH AND SAFETY WARNINGS
section4.content: The app is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice. Prior medical consultation recommended in many cases (heart problems, pain, injuries, pregnancy, etc.). Practice at your own risk; stop immediately in case of pain or discomfort. Limitation of Yuzu's liability for injuries, worsening of conditions, etc.

section5.title: 5. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
section5.content: All elements of the app belong to Yuzu or its partners. Personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable and revocable license for personal use only.

section6.title: 6. PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION
section6.content: Details in the Privacy Policy (data collected: first name, age/gender, goals, history, preferences, technical data). Secure hosting and GDPR compliance.

section7.title: 7. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
section7.content: App provided "as is". Exclusion of liability for direct/indirect damages, data loss, interruption, injuries. Maximum amount of damages: 100 euros (except willful misconduct or gross negligence).

section8.title: 8. DISPUTE RESOLUTION
section8.content: French law. Free mediation: AME Conso, 11 Place Dauphine, 75001 Paris — contact@mediationconso-ame.com — https://www.mediationconso-ame.com/ (after prior written approach to Yuzu). French courts have jurisdiction; European ODR platform for EU consumers.

section10.title: 10. SUBSCRIPTIONS AND PAYMENTS
section10.content: Yuzu Gold: monthly and annual subscriptions, automatic renewal via Apple/Google. Billing and receipts via Apple or Google account. Cancellation: Settings > Subscriptions (iOS) or Google Play > Subscriptions (Android); effect at end of current period. Free trial: indicated at subscription; automatic renewal at end of trial unless cancelled. Price changes possible; 30 days notice for increases; may cancel before new pricing. Refunds handled by Apple/Google; Yuzu does not handle refunds directly. Full subscription management via Apple or Google account.
